description: ValidateMyGrid publishes rules for checking power-infrastructure features in OpenStreetMap. Open Energy Transition and MapYourGrid maintain the rules for JOSM's data validator, with some also available through Osmose item 7040. The inputs are mapped power lines, substations and their tags; outputs are rule violations that a mapper can inspect and correct. Coverage depends on the OpenStreetMap area being checked and the state of its tags at the time of validation. The rules are free under the repository's MIT licence and can be installed in JOSM from its tag-checker rules list. The README links a separate power-network quality-assurance page. This is a preparation and quality tool, not a power-flow solver or a certified utility asset register. It cannot detect every missing facility or infer all electrical parameters. It helps improve network inputs for electricity topology and resilience simulations. The catalogue's data-gridkit-power-grid-extracts is a separate OSM-derived network product that could be checked against these rules; interoperability was not tested.
name: ValidateMyGrid OSM power QA rules
